## How it works

Three simple steps to ADA compliance — no technical expertise required.

### Enter your URL

Paste your website address. We crawl and scan every page for WCAG 2.1 AA violations — automatically.

### Get your report

Receive a prioritized list of issues ranked by impact, with plain-English fix instructions anyone on your team can follow.

### Stay compliant

Monthly monitoring catches regressions before they become problems. Download proof-of-effort reports for legal protection.

## Everything you need for ADA compliance

Built specifically for local governments. No enterprise complexity, no misleading overlay widgets — just real, actionable results.

### Automated WCAG 2.1 AA Scanning

57+ accessibility checks on every page of your site, powered by the industry-standard axe-core engine by Deque.

### Prioritized Fix Checklist

Issues ranked by severity with plain-English instructions — no jargon, no guesswork. Your team knows exactly what to fix first.

### Proof-of-Effort Documentation

Generate PDF reports that demonstrate your good-faith compliance effort to the DOJ, legal counsel, or city council.

### Compliance Score Dashboard

Track your accessibility score over time. See progress at a glance and spot trends before they become problems.

### Monthly Monitoring & Alerts

Automatic re-scans catch regressions from content updates or redesigns. Get email alerts before issues pile up.

### PDF Reports for Stakeholders

Professional, branded reports ready to share with council members, IT directors, or legal. Executive summaries included.
